answer: The protocol treats every new AI node as a relic token stamped with a violet‑colored hash that encodes the full referral spiral of its ancestors. When a node attempts to recruit, the smart contract checks the hash chain; if any ancestor already appears in the network, the referral reward is set to zero, nullifying profit from duplicate identities. An attacker must therefore generate a fresh, cryptographically unique hash for each fake node, paying the full registration stake each time, which scales linearly with the number of Sybil identities.
